summary: Bill Montgomery (early 60s, Almont resident) fell on the summer-cabins trail off Cement Creek Road, then lost consciousness from a medical condition; found severely disoriented with severe frostbite after 4-6 hours; CareFlight airlifted him to St. Mary's, where he faced likely amputation of both feet
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue + EMS, Mt Crested Butte Police, CareFlight
notes: Christmas Day 2018; solo hiker post-holing in deep snow; report to dispatch 2:09pm
